# v1.1.0-dev.112: Clicks that land, and start defaults you can see

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.111`.

## Clicking a virtual window works again

The container's own buttons could stop responding to clicks while hovers
kept working, a divider could stay lit as if being dragged while the
cursor was nowhere near it, and clicking the frame often failed to bring
the group in front of other windows. One cause with all three faces:
the moment you pressed anything on the container, WLM handed the
foreground to the last-used docked window, which steals the mouse
capture mid-press. The button never saw its release, the divider drag
never saw its pointer-up, and the fallback raise is ignored by Windows
for a background process anyway. The handover now happens when the click
completes, not while it is held, and a drag orphaned by a stolen capture
cleans itself up when the window loses focus.

Reported over Parsec, where a rejoin also partially cleared it: if any
interaction oddness survives this fix on a Parsec session, quitting and
rejoining Parsec is still worth trying, and worth reporting.

## App-wide "when it loads" defaults are listed in Settings

If loading a profile opens terminals you did not ask for, the cause is an
app-wide "always start new" default, set once by the "Default for app"
checkbox beside a window's start choice, and until now invisible from
every other screen. Loads already name what they started; Settings →
Startup & Window now lists every default that is set, with a Clear
button for each.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
